# And the Big Day has arrived!!! · 2026-08-15T00:00:00+00:00

And the Big Day has arrived!!!
On Friday 14 August, after months of hard work and planning, hours of meetings and hundreds of decisions we were ready to have our official Go live day for our new ambient site in Daventry!
And what a day it was: visitors and colleagues came together to celebrate the grand opening and a successful delivery of this project.
We are now ready to start the next chapter of our journey in increasing the capacity of the network and fulfill demand for the stores and ultimately put stock on the shelves!
The project had brought together colleagues from the GXO network and colleagues from the customer side and the level of commitment and professionalism shown was at the outmost standards!
A massive Thank you to everyone that helped us to get this site opened!!!
On a personal level this has been the highlight of my career and I will always be grateful for been given the opportunity to be part of it!

# Route2 Logistics officially opens new depot in Coatbridge

## Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity.

In Your Area Ian Bunting

22:50, 14 Aug 2026

View Image

Route2 owner Joe Wall and operations manager Rodger Caldwell

Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland.

The Coatbridge depot complements Route2’s established Dunfermline operation, creating a stronger Scotland-based network and enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

# 3 months ago, we opened the doors to our new UK warehouse. Since then, it has been anything but quiet. · 2026-07-31T00:00:00+00:00

3 months ago, we opened the doors to our new UK warehouse. Since then, it has been anything but quiet.

With 600 m² of warehouse space in Dover and 9,500 m² in Warwick, our UK presence is now even better equipped to support transport, fulfilment, customs and cross-dock operations.

For our customers, that means smoother flows between the UK and Europe, with Belgium as a strategic gateway. Add our Gateway2Britain and Gateway2Europe certificates, AEO-certified customs expertise and bonded warehouse solutions, and cross-border logistics becomes a lot less complicated.

We also offer daily and direct connections between Turkey and the UK, including groupage, part loads and full loads.

In short: more space, more flexibility and more ways to keep goods moving.
